description: JS Bank Limited was incorporated in Pakistan as a public limited company on 15 March 2006, and dates its origins to Jahangir Siddiqui & Co. Limited's acquisition of Citicorp Investment Bank Limited in 1999, which formed Jahangir Siddiqui Investment Bank Limited. The bank describes itself as one of the fastest growing banks in Pakistan with a domestic and international presence and a leadership position in digital financial services, SME and consumer lending.
headOffice: Shaheen Commercial Complex, Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed Road, Karachi-74200, Pakistan
